description: This file defines the InventoryRepository class, which manages inventory data in memory, including sample data initialization, CRUD operations, filtering, and pagination.

classes.name: InventoryRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing inventory items in memory, providing CRUD operations and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with sample data and sets up internal data structures.

methods.description: Populates the repository with predefined sample inventory items.

methods.description: Creates a new inventory item with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an inventory item by its unique ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing inventory item by ID with new data.

methods.name: bool delete(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an inventory item by ID.
